AGENDA

  633 E. Broadway, Room 105

Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  October 26, 2023

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM

  Present: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Jack Mavyan, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy, Alejandro Parajon
2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  A. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of October 26, 2023, was posted
  on October 23, 2023 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

  B. Brown Act Training – Lucy Varpetian, Principal Assistant City Attorney
  Ms. Varpetian provided a presentation to the Audit Committee regarding the
  Ralph M. Brown Act. Ms. Varpetian answered questions from the Committee
  members.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on July 27, 2023

  Moved: Thomas O’Shaughnessy  Seconded: Edmund Khashadourian
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy, Alejandro
  Parajon
  Noes: None
  Absent: None
  Abstain: Jack Mavyan

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A. Discussion re: potential modification to the Audit Committee regular
  meeting schedule

  1. Resolution modifying the Audit Committee regular meeting schedule
  1
   Ms. Zhang made a presentation to the Audit Committee on potentially modifying
  the Committee’s regular meeting schedule. Ms. Zhang answered questions from
  the Committee members.

  After discussing the alternative meeting schedules for the Audit Committee, the
  Committee members decided to keep the current schedule.

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 9/30/2023 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit
  Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on September 30,
  2023.
  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Principal Internal Auditor, made a presentation on
  the PCI Compliance Audit and answered questions from the Committee
  members.
  Ms. Ani Antanesyan, Senior Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the
  Business Registration Certificates Audit. Ms. Antanesyan and Ms. Tamar Sadd,
  Deputy Director of Community Development Department, answered questions
  from the Committee members.
  After the audit presentation, Ms. Zhang continued presenting the Internal Audit
  activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous
  audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory
  services and answered questions from the Committee members.
7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Committee member O’Shaughnessy noted that he would like to re-open Item 5a
  to discuss the alternatives to the current Audit Committee meeting schedule, but
  after brief discussion with other Committee members, he withdrew the initial
  request. The Committee members confirmed that they would keep the current
  meeting schedule for now and revisit if needed.
8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian  Seconded: Jack Mavyan

  Adjournment at 3:51 PM
